title: Comparison of pain patterns in hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome and Hypermobility Spectrum Disorders
summary: This is a study, where two diseases concerning connective tissue, Ehlers-Danlos-Syndrome and hypermobility spectrum disorder, are compared. The distribution of pain is compared. We also analyse if other disorders like attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and autism spectrum disorder have an influence on pain perception. Therefor we use pain drawings that are analyzed by a software.
conditions: Other specified behavioural and emotional disorders with onset usually occurring in childhood and adolescence
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnostic criteria of the international consortium on the Ehlers-Danlos syndromes
Exclusion criteria:
none
